article.title: Anatomy of a Caldera Collapse: Kīlauea 2018 Summit Seismicity Sequence in High Resolution
article.scientific_question: Resolve high-rate summit seismicity and collapse-cycle geometry during the 2018 Kīlauea eruption with waveform correlation and relative relocation.
article.sequence: 2018-04-29 through 2018-08-06 UTC; Kīlauea summit caldera-collapse sequence.
article.catalog_relationship: S1 is the high-resolution hypocentroid event catalog; S2 is its polarity-cluster subset; the phase CSV is a separate pick/association auxiliary product.

construction_workflow.summary: HVO template events were scanned through continuous HVO/IRIS waveforms; correlation-derived differential times were inverted with hypoDD, then approximate magnitudes and polarity clusters were produced.

input_data.name: HVO template events and phase picks
input_data.availability_conditions: Later runs preferentially used analyst-refined templates.

input_data.name: Continuous seismic waveforms
input_data.availability_conditions: Waveform availability and processing runs change through sequence.

evidence.note: Article waveform source and network caveat.

stages.name: Template construction
stages.purpose: Create P/S templates from catalog picks and estimate missing phase times.
stages.method: Phase-centered templates started 0.2 s before estimated arrivals; vp/vs 1.75 when one phase was absent.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Channels require at least one P or S pick.
stages.analyst_intervention: Later runs use analyst-refined templates where available.

evidence.locator: Text S1. Supporting Methods, Event detection and location procedure

stages.name: Continuous correlation detection
stages.purpose: Find similar events and precise differential arrivals.
stages.method: Sum channel correlation coefficients; derive detection reference/origin times and per-channel differential times.
stages.software_or_model: Correlation implementation following Shelly et al. (2016a)
qc_and_rejection_rules: Allow positive and negative correlation peaks.

evidence.locator: Text S1. Supporting Methods, Event detection and location procedure

stages.name: HypoDD relative relocation
stages.purpose: Sharpen event geometry using correlation and catalog differential times.
stages.method: hypoDD double-difference inversion with 1-D velocity model; waveform stations within 20 km and catalog picks within 70 km.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Final retention requires at least 10 P and 10 S correlation-derived differential times.
stages.analyst_intervention: HVO log runs and analyst-refined templates retained as provenance.

evidence.note: Relocation model, station radii, and run populations.

stages.name: Approximate magnitude estimation
stages.purpose: Assign relative/approximate magnitudes to newly detected events.
stages.method: Waveform amplitude ratios to HVO catalog earthquakes.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Do not use uncalibrated values for fine b-value scoring.

stages.name: Correlation-polarity clustering
stages.purpose: Group events by correlation-derived phase polarity.
stages.method: Hierarchical clustering of approximately 25 million polarity measurements.
qc_and_rejection_rules: S2 contains events receiving a polarity cluster label.
stages.analyst_intervention: No focal-mechanism inversion; clusters are source-family indicators.

construction_workflow.final_output: S1 high-resolution event catalog, S2 polarity-cluster subset, and separate phase-arrival auxiliary CSV.

evidence.locator: Catalog-construction workflow; Reported products and quality controls

related_products.name: USGS/HVO operational catalog baseline
related_products.catalog_relation: Independent Q3 operational baseline; not Shelly S1/S2.

scientific_findings.statement: Summit seismicity is resolved at high relative precision and organized into polarity/source families during repeated collapse cycles.
Run-level counts and station coverage change over time; rate comparisons require network/process covariates.

benchmark_context.quality_interpretation: Q1 for relative summit geometry of retained events; Q2 for dense detection under HVO/IRIS conditions.
benchmark_context.recommended_role: Primary summit reference; keep S1/S2 events and phase-level product separate.
benchmark_context.comparison_or_baseline_sources: Wei S1, Matoza 2021, Lengliné auxiliary, and USGS HVO operational baseline.
benchmark_context.valid_comparisons: Matched summit time/space/depth mask, event matching, relative geometry, and cluster recovery.
benchmark_context.caveats: Do not score island-wide completeness, absolute truth, or uncalibrated magnitudes; preserve summit depth datum and station lineage.

missing_information: Exact per-run station inventory and station-day waveform coverage are not in the local extraction.
No independent event-to-phase crosswalk beyond source fields.

missing_core_fields: fixed station count (not reported by article)
warnings: Approximate magnitudes are not a calibrated uniform scale.
Phase CSV row count is not an event count.
Summit-referenced depths require explicit datum handling.
